verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OMWANA wo nkukoowoola;
Era wansuubiza
Okutuusa ekyengera
Byonna ggwe-obigaba.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Tutunuulira ggwe wekka
Ekyeya bwe kijja;
Era ne ttoggo bw'atuuka,
Tukulindirira.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Enkuba-ebaza-ebibala
Era n'omusana;
Bwe bireeta ekyengera
Naffe tumalibwa.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Naye byetulina bibyo
Otuwe-olw'ekisa;
Tuwe tukwesige wekka
Kubanga-otwagala.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Kaakano ffe tukusaba
Byonna obituwe.
Tukugulumize wekka,
Katonda-atwagala.
